label: wm99-n4
_why: THE CANONISATION TEST FOR THE WORLD-MARKET MONOPOLY THRESHOLD (user-ruled 2026-10-19, BALANCE_FRAMEWORK 10.102 item 4: "n=4 under the monopoly to decide whether it gets canonised" - the decision for mod 1.0). Book config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-x25-m10ac-dpriv-wm99.json = the canon (sha256 fc7490eb6288514b, verified 2026-10-19) + game_defines.NEconomy.WORLD_MARKET_MONOPOLY_THRESHOLD 0.99 + the _wm99_variant record, nothing else (field diff re-proved 2026-10-19). The engine's default threshold is below 0.36, so in vanilla and in the canon every traded good's world price carries 0.2 x the top exporting market's share of world exports (+7% to +20%); at 0.99 only goods one market exports above 99% keep it (FINDINGS F241). Dry-run build clean 2026-10-19 (every lint, preflight).

_arms.wm99: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-x25-m10ac-dpriv-wm99.json} (+ its tree twin, the canon's byte for byte).

_comparison: THE BINDING ONE: vanilla n=16 (20260821_131149) for the wall-clock budget (play within +10%, wall_clusters.mjs, main median over clusters 1+2) and for the register (criteria.mjs). Economic context, each with its differences stated: F239 (jex-dam4s-rs-x25-m10ac, 20261016_092158, n=3: no private dams, no threshold; loss 6.72, wall 174.4 min = x1.06) and the treaty-port century F244 9 (20261019_020412_tp-prod-stitched-n3, n=3: this book + the treaty-port layers; 2 intact + 1 runoff, loss 7.82, wall 181.8 min = x1.10). The canon itself (private dams, no threshold) has never run a century: nothing here isolates the threshold from private dams.

_predictions.wall_clock: near the treaty-port century's x1.10 (that book minus a feature measured at +0.7% over ten years): ~x1.08-1.10 of vanilla, i.e. at the edge of the 10% budget. The threshold has no direct compute cost (one comparison per good); any cost comes through a different economy.
_predictions.trade: the leader markets export somewhat less of the goods they dominate (F241's one-year x0.92), importers a little more; world prices near the canon's after the first weeks of the campaign
_predictions.register: world GDP near F239's 1.02-1.12 and F244's 0.96-1.27; a runoff seed in four is possible (one in three in both F227 and F244 9); loss in the 6.5-8 band
